an3.23:1.1: tayome bhikkhave puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ
an3.23:1.3: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo sabyāpajjhaṃ kāyasaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti sabyāpajjhaṃ vacīsaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti sabyāpajjhaṃ manosaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti
an3.23:1.4: so sabyāpajjhaṃ kāyasaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharitvā sabyāpajjhaṃ vacīsaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharitvā sabyāpajjhaṃ manosaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharitvā sabyāpajjhaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati
an3.23:1.5: tamenaṃ sabyāpajjhaṃ lokaṃ upapannaṃ samānaṃ sabyāpajjhā phassā phusanti
an3.23:1.6: so sabyāpajjhehi phassehi phuṭṭho samāno sabyāpajjhaṃ vedanaṃ vediyati ekantadukkhaṃ seyyathāpi sattā nerayikā
an3.23:2.1: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco puggalo abyāpajjhaṃ kāyasaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti abyāpajjhaṃ vacīsaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti abyāpajjhaṃ manosaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti
an3.23:2.2: so abyāpajjhaṃ kāyasaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharitvā abyāpajjhaṃ vacīsaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharitvā abyāpajjhaṃ manosaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharitvā abyāpajjhaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati
an3.23:2.3: tamenaṃ abyāpajjhaṃ lokaṃ upapannaṃ samānaṃ abyāpajjhā phassā phusanti
an3.23:2.4: so abyāpajjhehi phassehi phuṭṭho samāno abyāpajjhaṃ vedanaṃ vediyati ekantasukhaṃ seyyathāpi devā subhakiṇhā
an3.23:3.1: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco puggalo sabyāpajjhampi abyāpajjhampi kāyasaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti sabyāpajjhampi abyāpajjhampi vacīsaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti sabyāpajjhampi abyāpajjhampi manosaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti
an3.23:3.2: so sabyāpajjhampi abyāpajjhampi kāyasaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharitvā sabyāpajjhampi abyāpajjhampi vacīsaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharitvā sabyāpajjhampi abyāpajjhampi manosaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharitvā sabyāpajjhampi abyāpajjhampi lokaṃ upapajjati
an3.23:3.3: tamenaṃ sabyāpajjhampi abyāpajjhampi lokaṃ upapannaṃ samānaṃ sabyāpajjhāpi abyāpajjhāpi phassā phusanti
an3.23:3.4: so sabyāpajjhehipi abyāpajjhehipi phassehi phuṭṭho samāno sabyāpajjhampi abyāpajjhampi vedanaṃ vediyati vokiṇṇasukhadukkhaṃ seyyathāpi manussā ekacce ca devā ekacce ca vinipātikā
an3.23:3.5: ime kho bhikkhave tayo puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasminti. 24
